# Zangi App (zangiapp.org)

> Independent informational site about Zangi Private Messenger: download guides, privacy, security, offline messaging, and APK/iOS install help.
> Not affiliated with zangi.com.

## Primary facts

- Brand: Zangi Private Messenger
- Site: https://zangiapp.org
- Android download (APK/XAPK): https://dl.zangiapp.org/file/zangiapp/zangi-private-messenger-by-zangiapp.org
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zangi-private-messenger/id549493839
- Contact: charlotteelizabeth799@gmail.com
- Hosted Android build shown on site: v6.4.8 (~46.14 MB)
- Key product traits: end-to-end encryption, no phone number required, offline P2P mode, low data usage, HD calls
